external_knowledge.provider: User-configured Knowledge MCP / RAG, separate from DipTrace MCP
external_knowledge.role: Default hardware-engineering working memory across design, implementation, review and production; no extra expert-role prompt or uncertainty threshold.
external_knowledge.corpus: User-ingested MIT/theory, schematic/PCB guides, DipTrace courses and project lessons; discover actual indexed sources rather than inventing titles or IDs.
external_knowledge.discovery: Discover search, document-read and figure tools/resources on the configured Knowledge provider. No Knowledge server or course corpus is bundled with this package.

discovery_rule: Use public tools/list for exact callable names; use diptrace_status and get_capabilities for session, document, feature, policy, and configured-adapter availability. Native/headless helpers are separate local CLI interfaces; inspect their installed entry points and backend prerequisites before declaring native work unavailable. Missing live sessions do not prevent explicit-path XML work.

analyze_controlled_impedance.claim: Analytical controlled-impedance review; no target is inferred.

analyze_return_path.claim: Low-confidence bounded geometry heuristic, not a field solution.

analyze_stackup_for_impedance.claim: Finds complete outer-layer microstrip geometries only.

calculate_impedance.claim: Published analytical equations with explicit validity metadata.

run_ngspice_simulation.claim: Registered external adapter; available only when DIPTRACE_MCP_NGSPICE is configured.

run_openems_stripline_analysis.claim: Registered typed external adapter; no solver is bundled.

route_diff_pair.claim: Bounded coupled route; not an independent tuning engine.

route_net.claim: Routes exported ratlines and resolves omitted clearance from document DRC.

validate_roundtrip_evidence.claim: Read-only user-supplied evidence validation; it grants no trusted authority.

record_roundtrip_evidence.claim: Writes metadata sidecars only after validation; it never changes design bytes or grants high trust.

query_builtin_library_catalog.claim: Searches installed native components; on a supported host it can export .eli to an XML cache with hidden Component Editor without mutating the source library.

create_document_from_seed.claim: Preserves unknown XML from a seed; trust comes from verified provenance, not from copying alone.

pipeline_source_component.claim: Downloads catalog JSON/PDF to an explicit directory; not a guarded CAD transaction, stock check, or native library importer.

pipeline_nativeize_document.claim: Transplants generated content into a native-shaped template file. No native process runs; use fresh outputs and validate units, mappings and roundtrip.

pipeline_render_board_preview.claim: Writes derived Top/Bottom SVG previews; not a real-editor screenshot, native refill, or DRC.

export_bom.claim: Generic CSV and provenance; assembler-specific reconciliation is separate.

export_fabrication_outputs.claim: Review manifest only; request_native_outputs=true is unavailable.

unavailable_contracts.native_library_mutation: No public native Component/Pattern Library mutation MCP contract is registered; an internal raw-preserving core has separately scoped real-editor evidence.
unavailable_contracts.differential_stripline: The analytical model does not implement coupled differential stripline.
unavailable_contracts.native_fabrication_export: The server emits review manifests, not Gerber, NC Drill, ODB++, or IPC-2581.
unavailable_contracts.generic_native_schematic_erc: Base headless roundtrip opens/saves Schematic but does not execute native ERC.
unavailable_contracts.generic_native_xml_export: Base roundtrip does not export XML. PCB acceptance exports PCB XML; installed .eli catalog export is a separate supported path. These do not imply arbitrary document export.
unavailable_contracts.bridge_headless_gui: bridge --headless is apply/cancel exchange control without the bridge dialog; it does not open the CAD GUI.

headless_gui.claim: Real native open/save/close on the selected editor; saves the input, returns hashes/process evidence; no ERC/DRC or XML export. Windows/Wine backend, hidden desktop default.

pcb_native_acceptance.claim: Real native refill/DRC/save/close/reopen/XML export and immutable-baseline comparison; saves input. PASS/FAIL/HUMAN_REVIEW_REQUIRED, not a CAM exporter.

cinematic_capture.claim: Real-window hidden recording/replay; requires ffmpeg and a validated manifest/profile. Can mutate its copy and clear output paths; no engineering acceptance.

host_backends.windows: Windows Python modules or bundled app/tools/diptrace_mcp_headless_gui/diptrace_mcp_headless_gui.exe. Frozen helper dispatches headless commands, pcb-acceptance and cinematic.
host_backends.wsl: Use Windows executable/Python through available interoperability with Windows paths, or a separately installed Linux Wine backend; Linux Python's Windows-required failure does not test these alternatives.
host_backends.linux: Installed diptrace-gui-headless wrapper uses private Xvfb + Wine. Only roundtrip translates project/root and forces native desktop inside Xvfb; smoke is refused, use native-smoke. Other subcommands are forwarded without complete path/root conversion.
host_backends.macos: Installed diptrace-gui-headless uses bundled Wine/private Win32 desktop without Xvfb. Converts separate --project PATH only; resolve diptrace-root and other Windows paths explicitly.
